articles.summary: Restaurant Brands International Inc. ("RBI") (NYSE: QSR) (TSX: QSR) (TSX: QSP) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Josh Kobza, Chief Executive Officer of RBI commented, "At our Investor Day earlier this year, we highlighted what makes RBI a strong business – four iconic global brands, the ability to invest for long-term growth, and talented teams and franchisees around the world. Those strengths are on display again this quarter, with over 3% global comparable sales led by outperformance at Burger King and steady growth at International and Tim Hortons. I'm proud of what we're accomplishing together. Across our brands, we're continuing to listen to our guests and act on their feedback to deliver the quality, service, and convenience they expect every day." articles.title: Restaurant Brands International Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
